tapeLine: Wednesday 11 November: S&P 500 +1.3% to 7,619.38; Dow +0.5% to 52,486.49; Nasdaq Composite +1.6% to 25,466.19; Russell 2000 +0.9% to 2,846.26, per close reports dated 11 Nov. Nvidia fell sharply after hours and premarket Thursday (see overnight).
matters:
Stocks recovered Tuesday’s CPI loss on Wednesday, led by chips and AI infrastructure after CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue of $3.66 billion beat the $3.55 billion estimate; CoreWeave closed +24.7% at $60.77 and Nebius +15.4%. The bond market was closed for Veterans Day, so there was no Treasury reaction to the inflation print.

After the close, Nvidia fell more than 8% on reports from the New York Times of a second alleged affair involving CEO Jensen Huang and a Wall Street Journal report that the board is preparing to remove him. Nvidia has announced no decision. Nasdaq-100 futures were reported lower early Thursday. Treasuries reopen today, the first trading in bonds since the hotter October CPI.

alsoOnTape: Gold, VIX, oil and 10-year yield levels were not found with a clean dated source and are not carried. Wednesday coverage said oil rose after Iran said its enriched nuclear material will not leave the country; no price level is carried. October PPI is due Friday 13 Nov, not today.
overnight: Latest confirmed close — Wednesday 11 November: S&P 500 7,619.38 (+1.3%); Nasdaq Composite 25,466.19 (+1.6%); Dow 52,486.49 (+0.5%).

Nvidia — fell more than 8% after hours Wednesday. Premarket Thursday snapshots varied by source and timestamp, from about −6% (Seeking Alpha, Yahoo data) to −8.6% (Benzinga). Seeking Alpha reported CFO Colette Kress may be interim CEO; Nvidia has not confirmed any change.
Futures — CNBC’s live coverage reported Nasdaq-100 futures sliding as the Nvidia sell-off resumed; no clean dated percentage was found and none is carried.
Peers — AMD and Broadcom were reported up 3.9% and 3% premarket respectively in the same coverage.
macro: Nvidia governance — reports say the board is weighing Huang’s future; one report says it met Wednesday, another that it may meet as early as Thursday. Nvidia’s earnings are scheduled for 17 Nov.
Treasuries — reopen today with no market read yet on October CPI (+0.4% m/m headline, +0.3% core, BLS 10 Nov).
CoreWeave — said it expects adjusted profitability in the first half of 2028, per close coverage dated 11 Nov.
flow: Breadth, dealer gamma, put-call and skew are paid data and are not on this page.

regime.tag: AI trade rebounded on CoreWeave, then single-name governance risk at Nvidia hit after the close.
regime.sizing: How much of Wednesday’s Nasdaq gain survives Nvidia’s premarket drop is unresolved, and today is the first Treasury session since CPI.

secondOrder: Nvidia’s weight means a single-stock governance story can move index futures independent of macro data; reported premarket strength in AMD and Broadcom suggests some rotation within chips rather than a uniform sector move. That is an observation, not a forecast.

scorecard.text: The prior brief said whether Wednesday’s early futures strength would survive the cash open was unresolved. It did: S&P 500 +1.3%, Nasdaq +1.6%. No direction was called, so there is nothing to grade right or wrong.
The prior brief noted Thursday is the first chance for a Treasury reaction to CPI. Bonds reopen today; no yield data yet to assess.
